caption_fb:
December 6 in Poland is Mikołajki (mee-koh-WHY-kee), St. Nicholas Day.

Children clean their shoes or boots the night before and wake up to small gifts: sweets, an orange, sometimes a little toy. A child who misbehaved might find a twig instead (rózga, ROOZ-gah).

Many Polish American families kept it for generations.

Did yours? Tell us in the comments 👇
